label: copy phase, mid/late recall, input token 1/a/y/w
explanation: Update-gate unit that is active almost only in the copy phase: 96% of activation mass falls there, it is essentially silent in the original phase, and it is weak at <DEL> and at recall_idx 0-1. The activation rate rises with t and L (L=9 accounts for 54% of mass; rate is highest at recall_idx 3-4 and 7-8). Inside the copy phase it depends strongly on the fed-back input token: 1 (29% rate), a (23%), y (19%), w (14%), with weaker rates for c/q/n. The top activations are usually a 1/a/y/w input in the middle of the copy, often followed by smaller activations on the next few tokens that fade out. Predicate: copy phase, recall_idx>=2, input token in {1,a,y,w}. Dev scores: P 0.56, R 0.52, F1 0.54, mass recall 0.66. Larger magnitudes are better covered (top-quartile coverage 0.80). Misses are the spillover activations on tokens after a trigger and low-magnitude firing on other tokens. False positives are trigger tokens at early or short copy positions. Never fires on original-phase inputs.
